description_en: Queries the details of an asset (ECS instance)
description_zh: 查询资产（ECS服务器）的详细信息
name: DescribeAssetDetailByUuids

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the asset instances. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资产实例的UUID列表。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

AssetType.description_en:
The type of the asset.

The only valid value is 0, which indicates an ECS instance
AssetType.description_zh:
资产的类型。

唯一取值为0，表示ECS服务器

AuthModifyTime.description_en: The timestamp when the asset authorization was bound. Unit: milliseconds
AuthModifyTime.description_zh: 资产授权绑定的时间戳，单位为毫秒

AuthVersion.description_en:
The authorization version of the asset. Valid values:

1: Free Edition (unauthorized)
6: Anti-virus Edition
5: Advanced Edition
3: Enterprise Edition
7: Ultimate Edition
AuthVersion.description_zh:
资产的授权版本。取值：

1：免费版（未授权）
6：防病毒版
5：高级版
3：企业版
7：旗舰版

Bind.description_en:
Indicates whether the asset is bound to an authorization. Valid values:

true: bound to an authorization
false: not bound to an authorization
Bind.description_zh:
资产是否已绑定授权。取值：

true：已绑定授权
false：未绑定授权

ClientStatus.description_en:
The status of the China China China agent client. Valid values:
online: online
offline: offline
ClientStatus.description_zh:
Agent客户端状态。取值：
online：在线
offline：离线

ClientVersion.description_en: The version of the agent client

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when Security Center recorded the asset information. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 云安全中心记录当前资产信息的时间戳，单位为毫秒

items.description_en:
The disk information. The following parameters describe the disk:
diskName: the disk name.
totalSize: the total disk capacity. Unit: GB.
useSize: the used disk capacity. Unit: GB.
useSizeByte: the used disk capacity. Unit: bytes.
totalSizeByte: the total disk capacity. Unit: bytes
items.description_zh:
磁盘信息。以下是磁盘相关参数的说明：
diskName：磁盘名称。
totalSize：磁盘总容量，单位为GB。
useSize：已使用磁盘容量，单位为GB。
useSizeByte：已使用磁盘容量，单位为Byte。
totalSizeByte：已使用磁盘容量，单位为Byte

Flag.description_en:
The asset vendor. Valid values:

0: Alibaba Cloud asset
1: asset outside the cloud
2: IDC asset
3, 4, 5, 7: third-party cloud asset
8: lightweight asset
Flag.description_zh:
资产厂商。取值：

0：阿里云资产
1：云外资产
2：IDC资产
3、4、5、7：其它云资产
8：轻量级资产

GroupTrace.description_en: The group to which the server belongs. Servers that are not assigned to a group belong to the Ungrouped group by default
GroupTrace.description_zh: 服务器所属的分组。未设置分组的服务器默认属于未分组

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the asset

InstanceName.description_en: The instance name of the asset

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the server

Ip.description_en:
The IP address of the server.

If a public IP address exists, this value is the public IP address. If no public IP address exists but a private IP address exists, this value is the private IP address
Ip.description_zh:
服务器的IP。

公网IP存在则该值为公网IP，公网IP不存在私网IP存在则为私网IP

IpList.description_en: The list of IP addresses of the server

items.description_en: The IP address of the server

Kernel.description_en: The Milvus version of the operating system kernel

Os.description_en: The operating system type of the server
Os.description_zh: 服务器的操作系统类型

OsDetail.description_en: The operating system version and architecture of the server
OsDetail.description_zh: 服务器的操作系统版本位数

OsName.description_en: The name of the operating system of the server asset
OsName.description_zh: 服务器资产的操作系统名称

Region.description_en: The region in which the server resides

RegionId.description_en:
The region in which the server resides.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html）
RegionId.description_zh:
服务器所在地域。
Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html）

RegionName.description_en: The name of the region in which the server resides

SysInfo.description_en: The operating system information of the server
SysInfo.description_zh: 服务器的操作系统信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
